title: Detection rule
description: How to read series, chapter and images from one site. Rules are data only; fixed evaluator code interprets them. See contracts/README.md for the evaluation semantics.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the rule was written against.

domain.description: Lowercase host the rule was made for, without a port. Subdomains are separate rules.

version.description: Increases by one each time the rule for this domain is regenerated.

confidence.description: Health score kept by the server. Successful extractions raise it, failures lower it.

fingerprint.description: 64-bit simhash of the page structure as 16 lowercase hex digits. Lets a mirror domain inherit this rule.

urlPattern.description: RE2 regular expression matched against the whole page URL. No lookaround, no backreferences, no inline flags. Named groups use (?<name>...).

selector.description: CSS selector from the supported subset in contracts/README.md.

attribute.description: Where the value comes from. "text" is the element's text content with whitespace collapsed. Any other value is an attribute name.

extract.description: Reads one value from the first element the selector matches.

pattern.description: Optional RE2 pattern applied to the value. It must have a named group "value", which becomes the result. No match gives no value.

link.description: Reads a URL from the first element the selector matches and resolves it against the page URL.

images.description: Reads one image URL from every element the selector matches, in document order.

attributes.description: Attributes tried in order; the first non-empty one wins. "srcset" picks its largest candidate. Lazy loaders usually need data-src before src.

url.description: Matches chapter page URLs. A group named "series" gives the series slug. A group named "chapter" gives the chapter when chapterLabel finds nothing.

title.description: Series title as shown on the page.

chapterLabel.description: Chapter label as shown on the page, for example "Vol. 2 Ch. 15".

url.description: Matches series page URLs. A group named "series" gives the series slug.

title.description: Series title as shown on the page.

chapterLinks.description: Matches every chapter link in the chapter list. Each match gives its resolved href and its text as the label.
